integrity: The witness expectations use exact rational first-vertex recursion and independent exhaustive permutation counts. Minimality through eight vertices is established by complete Prüfer enumeration, complete unrooted-tree canonicalization, and exhaustive proper bare-path shifts. Verification is included in verify.py.
scientific_limitations: The result establishes the first finite counterexample to proper KC-monotonicity of expected uniform random-order greedy independent-set cardinality. It does not contradict global path minimality, prove an infinite counterfamily, or address other greedy-colouring statistics. Publication priority beyond inspected literature requires independent evaluation.
title: A nine-vertex counterexample to KC-monotonicity of random greedy independent sets
